_comment: Hand-authored natural-language behavioural queries for xxHash-dev (v0.8.x). Queries describe behaviour, not identifiers. Labels were assigned by reading the function source in base.json BEFORE any retrieval was run on this project; no retrieval output, embedding, or LLM enrichment was consulted. grade 2 = the function that directly implements the described behaviour (several equivalent copies of a helper, e.g. test-buffer fillers, are all grade 2); grade 1 = a variant, wrapper or closely supporting function. Single annotator (AI-assisted authoring); NOT independently reviewed by a second human.
